subject: parameterization of exponential and double_exponential distributions in Stan

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: parameterization of exponential and double_exponential distributions in Stan
parts:
A funny thing: exponential distribution is parameterized in terms of inverse-scale, but double_exponential is parameterized in terms of its scale. For historical reasons I understand this but maybe we should flag it in the manual.
A
